name: two coupled spins, field on the second spin
question: Does the transverse magnetization of the first spin still rotate when the transverse field acts on the second spin?
assumptions: Closed unitary dynamics; hbar = 1; energies and rates in one arbitrary unit.
The model of examples/quantum/two_spins.json with its field moved: H = g Z0 Z1 + h X1, observable X0.

provenance.origin: authored control for the closure of the observable (tutorial Chapter 24, Section 6)
